course_name_original: Inglés para la ciencia y la técnica

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Define the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, and making correct use of language, in writing.
Define the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, and making correct use of language orally.

syllabus_topics: Current topics in Science and Technology
Analytical skills for reading articles, paying attention to classes, watching audiovisual programs and discussing current research
Questions for selecting a research topic
Search, collection, analysis and organization of information
Strengthening comprehension through dictations, closed exercises, note-taking and other activities
Focus on common vocabulary and expressions in science and technology
teaching_methods: Individual study and work, tests, exams and/or checkpoints
Teacher's presentation in the classroom, in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects
Completion of exercises individually and in teams
Computer simulation practices, individually and/or in teams

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject
Team oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject

assessment_rules: Individual written and oral tests account for 70% of the grade, and team oral tests account for 30%. There are no recovery mechanisms for the assessment components.
